description: This file defines the BotProjectDashboardController class within the GoteoBot namespace. It extends a base project dashboard controller to include functionalities related to bot project integrations, such as creating sidebar links and handling integration actions involving Telegram bot tokens.

classes.name: GoteoBot\Controller\BotProjectDashboardController
classes.description: A controller handling bot project dashboard functionalities, including integration with Telegram bots, extending the project dashboard.

methods.name: createBotSidebar
methods.description: Static method to potentially add a bot-related link to the project sidebar if the user has edit permissions.

methods.name: integrationAction
methods.description: Handles the integration action for the project, generating a Telegram bot start URL with a base64-encoded project ID token.
